response.sql: WITH product_item_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, count, count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM product_item_counts) as share FROM product_item_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.count) as combined_count, AVG(s.share) as average_share, AVG(s.share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as average_excess FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)
